name: NeuS Training Loss
aliases: Neural Implicit Surface Reconstruction Training Loss
definition: The training objective for Neural Implicit Surface (NeuS) reconstruction, combining photometric, geometric, and regularization losses to optimize a signed distance field (SDF) and opacity field.
summary: NeuS Training Loss optimizes neural implicit surfaces from images by combining photometric, Eikonal, and mask losses to ensure sharp geometry without 3D ground truth.
